lessons.title: How High Did It Go? Energy Preview
lessons.focus: Estimate peak from flight time; KE→PE story; measure throw heights off a marked wall.
lessons.advanced: Equate ½mv²=mgh to show h=v²/2g; find launch speed for a 5 m mango-branch clearance.

lessons.title: Projectile Motion I: Sideways and Down Are Independent
lessons.focus: Roll ball off table while dropping another: same landing time; horizontal steady + vertical accelerates.
lessons.advanced: Ball leaves 1.25 m table at 3.0 m/s: compute flight time and range.

lessons.title: Projectile Motion II: Angle and Range
lessons.focus: Throw stones at measured angles; 45° wins (no air); 30° and 60° tie; javelin angle reality ~35°.
lessons.advanced: Explain with range formula R=v²sin2θ/g why 45° maximizes range; why do javelin throwers use less?

lessons.title: The Water Rocket Project I: Pressure and Design
lessons.focus: Bottle + water + air pressure = rocket; action-reaction and momentum preview; fin/nose design drawings.
lessons.advanced: Sketch forces on the rocket at launch: thrust, weight, drag; when is acceleration greatest?

lessons.title: The Water Rocket Project II: Build Day
lessons.focus: Construct fins, nose cone, payload bay; check symmetry and straight flight path; launcher safety briefing.
lessons.advanced: Compute centre of pressure vs centre of gravity positions; why must CG lead CP for stable flight?

lessons.title: The Water Rocket Project III: Launch and Measure
lessons.focus: Vary water fill (1/4, 1/3, 1/2) and launch angle; measure range and flight time; crown the champion with data.
lessons.advanced: From flight time and angle, estimate launch speed; explain the optimum fill fraction using mass vs impulse.

lessons.title: Physics of Kenyan Athletics
lessons.focus: Julius Yego's javelin angles, Eliud Kipchoge's pacing (steady speed = efficiency); analyze race splits from data cards.
lessons.advanced: Kipchoge: 42.195 km in 2:01:09 — compute average speed and per-km pace; compare with your dash.

lessons.title: Orbits and Satellites: Falling Around the Earth
lessons.focus: Throw harder and farther until you orbit; Kenya's space milestones (Uhuru-1, Taifa-1) and why satellites don't fall.
lessons.advanced: Explain weightlessness in orbit as continuous free fall, not absence of gravity.

lessons.title: The Coin and Feather Problem
lessons.focus: Attempt near-vacuum demo in a bottle with pump; failing that, reason from parachute data: without air, all fall together.
lessons.advanced: Write the argument that closes the case even if the demo is imperfect: what evidence settles it?

lessons.title: Unit Review: Gravity Games
lessons.focus: Stations: drop timing, parachute race, projectile range, egg-drop finals; unit quiz.
lessons.advanced: Combined problem: a stone thrown horizontally at 8 m/s from a 20 m cliff — time, range, impact speed.
